from.name: Katrien Wouters
from.org: Deklerck & Partners, an audit firm with 90 auditors

subject: New sampling module from January
mail: From 1 January our audit software makes the new statistical sampling module mandatory on every engagement. None of our auditors have used it; it replaces the spreadsheet everyone built themselves. Can we get them up to speed before busy season?
snippets: The module is mandatory under the firm's updated audit methodology.
The software vendor offers a sandbox environment.
why: It's a genuinely new, mandatory skill that nobody has yet, with a fixed deadline and a safe place to practise, so hands-on training in the sandbox is the right lever.

hidden_facts.fact: Not one auditor has used the module, and the old spreadsheets will be blocked from January.
hidden_facts.reveal_line: Nobody has touched it. And the old spreadsheets are blocked from January.

hidden_facts.fact: The vendor's sandbox has realistic sample data, so auditors can practise on a mock engagement.
hidden_facts.reveal_line: The vendor gave us a sandbox with a fake client. It's called 'Example NV'. Very imaginative.

debrief: Sometimes the request is exactly right. A new mandatory tool, no prior experience and no workaround is a real skill gap. The craft is in making it practical: a short sandbox session on a mock engagement just before busy season beats a long demo in November.
